label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.13… supports What is maximal in a GENUS_2 is the cause…
note: Only at being, and only with two open premises: with the order by approach of q.3 a.5 ad 2, strict primacy (STMT-NOTHING-ELSE-REACHES-THE-PRIMARY) and that everything other than the primary is a creature (STMT-OTHERS-THAN-PRIMARY-ARE-CREATURES) it yields the instance r = esse (QUARTA-VIA-ATTRIBUTION-GENUS-PRINCIPLE-AT-BEING). It says nothing about the principle for other perfections, such as heat, and closes nothing.
